svg.aria-label: keystone hero: a Tang server for clevis network-bound disk encryption, running as a Cloudflare Worker. Title and tagline on the left above a stone arch held by its keystone; on the right, a four-tile data sheet covering flow (in, out) and discipline (posture, lifetime). Bottom line: territory tags and license.

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: KEYSTONE · TANG SERVER · NETWORK-BOUND DISK ENCRYPTION
A Tang server for clevis network-bound disk encryption,
running as a Cloudflare Worker, wire-compatible with stock tangd.
binds the disk, never sees its key
a pin's advertisement fetch and recovery POST
never sees the disk key, only blinded points
a JWS advertisement and the recovered point
a set keeps its keys; rotation names a new one
